title: Sequence Game Tournament
tagline: A tournament harness where sequence models play iterated games against each other.
description: Sequence Game Tournament pits sequence models against each other in iterated game-theoretic settings — cooperation, defection, bluffing, retaliation — and records full transcripts so strategies can be analyzed rather than just scored. The harness handles matchmaking, payoff matrices, and round-robin scheduling; the analysis layer extracts emergent strategies per model.

Validated at small scale: distinct, reproducible strategy profiles emerge per model family, and some models learn to condition on opponent history within a single tournament. Pre-print on GitHub; scaling the tournament matrix is compute-bound.
